cards.name: O-Cedar EasyWring Microfiber Spin Mop and Bucket
cards.badge: Product of the day · the value pick in spin mops
cards.price: About $35–$40 at major retailers: Target $34.99, Lowe's $34.98, Walmart rollback $34.96 (undated snippets seen Oct 2, 2026); sales near $25–$30 reported at Lowe's and Costco
cards.buy_if: you have sealed hardwood, tile, vinyl or laminate and want a mop that wrings itself dry without bending, for about the price of two Swiffer refill boxes.
cards.skip_if: you want a machine that scrubs and vacuums (look at a floor washer such as a Bissell CrossWave), or you have unsealed or waxed wood, where any wet mop is a risk.
cards.owners: Home Depot shoppers rate it 4.4 out of 5 from about 4,160 reviews, 81% recommending it (search summary, Oct 5, 2026). Praised for the pedal wringer and nearly dry floors; the handle is the most-cited weak point.
cards.video_title: O-Cedar EasyWring Microfiber Spin Mop Review & Demo
cards.video_why: A demo of the pedal wringer and the triangle head in use; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The standard EasyWring 1-tank system (mop, bucket, one head); a bundle with 2–3 extra heads when the price per head is lower. Not the RinseClean two-tank model, which is a different product
buy.check: Sold by Amazon.com or O-Cedar; the listing title says EasyWring; buy refills labelled for your system. Generic heads sell for about $3 each but fit and durability were not checked
